name: tools-smw-customizer
title: SMW Customizer
description:
This tool allows for the easy customization of over 100 miscellaneous properties of the Super Mario World ROM. It's an easy-to-use program with a GUI, and allows you to edit anything from the speed of Bullet Bills, to how many points you get when collecting a 3-UP moon, to what sprite is spawned when you bring a P-switch to the goal, and much more!

Credit not necessary (but appreciated).
